claim_closed: Current evidence does not support a universal or domain-independent scalar, curve, or state-only metric that reveals remaining recoverability across unrelated systems.
surviving_intuition: Options can disappear before catastrophe, and execution delay can remove the last useful intervention.
scientific_correction: The missing variable is the transition under intervention. Recoverability is a property of state/history, action, lag, target, constraints, and their outcome distribution together.
reopen_only_if: same or credibly matched contexts are evaluated under different actions
execution lag is varied within matched context-action pairs
successful and failed recoveries are both represented
the data contain remedy-divergence cases under matched context
a strong action-conditioned transition model is the first comparator
terrynce_curve_role_if_reopened: Display/compression of action-set contraction computed by a domain transition model; not a universal predictor.
openline_role: record the transition model, target, constraints, actions, and lags used
derive and receipt the feasible action set
enforce mandate/authority separately from physical feasibility
reopen prior decisions when the feasible or authorized action set changes
